verdict.rationale: Ramp explicitly documents AI reading and processing incoming bills: invoices dragged in are auto-matched to POs, auto-coded to GL, and routed for approval before payment, with dedicated AI agents handling auto-coding and payment while guaranteeing 'no money ever moves without a human confirmation,' preserving a review step. The Bill Payments API and CLI further support creating/approving bills programmatically with attached documents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of AI invoice-reading accuracy, and the documented gap that bill approvals aren't yet available via MCP (must use UI or API).
